description: Use when someone wants a postcard made or sent from a photo. Creates an unpaid draft from one photo, with an optional note and recipient address, and returns a link to it; it never charges money or mails a postcard. The person finishes the note and address and pays on the website: $5 with postage included for a 4×6 card, mailed from the US to 194 countries.

challenge.description: The id of a challenge this tool answered with, and the answers to its four questions in the order asked, each a short string. The proof-of-work question takes a few million SHA-256 hashes.

is_ai_generated.description: True when the image is AI-generated. The website then keeps the original and makes an illustrated version only if the person chooses Illustrated.

note.description: The note for the back of the card. Up to 350 characters.

photo.description: A file reference to an image uploaded or generated in this conversation, with download_url and file_id filled in by the host. Exactly one of photo, photo_base64 or photo_url is required.

photo_base64.description: The image file's own bytes as base64 or a data: URL. JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to about 10 MB.

photo_url.description: A public https:// URL of an image that is already online.

recipient.description: Whatever is known of the recipient's mailing address; every field is optional. country is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code such as US.

name: send_postcard

continue_url.description: The same link as url, for agents that carry checkout on in a browser.

url.description: The link the person opens to finish and pay for the postcard. It expires after about a week.

title: Create postcard draft
